title: Fix fire-and-forget training harness error tracking
description:
P1 finding (P1-019). Training harness is launched via _ = Task.Run(() => RunHarnessAsync(...), CancellationToken.None) — the returned task is discarded. If RunHarnessAsync throws, the exception is completely invisible. Attach a continuation that logs exceptions, and use stoppingToken instead of CancellationToken.None.

File: MemorySmith.App/Services/Training/ (line ~226)
Confidence: 95%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
